goal: Stop nodes routed through a proxy from self-advertising proxy exit IPs
Prevents polluting peer address tables across the network with unreachable addresses
agreement: Broad agreement that advertising unreachable proxy addresses harms the network
Support because it stops advertising addresses nodes cannot be reached on (0xB10C, naiyoma)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because widespread addrman pollution from Tor exit nodes degrades peer discovery across the network
Address snapshots showed the majority of known Tor exit nodes gossiped as fresh entries
